qr.subtitle: Design how this QR code looks. It always opens this address, so printed codes keep working.
qr.unavailable: A QR code is not available for this item.
qr.load_failed: The QR settings could not be loaded.
qr.read_only: You can preview and download this QR code; only account owners and admins can change its design.
qr.preview_unsaved: Exact preview of the file (not saved yet)
qr.preview_sketch: Approximate preview; the exact one needs the latest API
qr.preview_invalid: Enter valid colors to see the preview.
qr.payload_hint: The QR code encodes this fixed address, never the target. Changing where it points or how it looks never changes the code, so printed copies keep working.
qr.quiet_zone_hint: The empty margin around the code. Keep at least 4 modules.
qr.logo_pick_media: This profile has no image of that kind. Pick the other image or upload one in the profile first.
qr.logo_hint: Uses a profile photo or cover from this account (PNG/JPEG, up to 2 MB), up to 30% of the code width. A logo switches to the highest error correction (H).
qr.download_save_first: Save your changes to download this design.
support.cards_subtitle: Find a card by serial, smart code or card UID across every account.
support.cards_search: Serial, smart code or card UID
support.routes_subtitle: Find a path, see where it points, its history and quarantine.
support.search_hint: Type at least 2 characters to search.
support.retire_desc: Card {{code}} will show "card deactivated" and its path is never handed out again. An unused activation code is cleared. This cannot be undone.
support.reassign_desc: Card {{code}} moves to the profile below, with its account and owner. The printed code and URL stay the same.
support.release_desc: /{{path}} is free right away and a new smart link can take it. Links that are still printed or shared may then reach someone else.
qr.templates_hint: A template sets shapes and colors; your logo and quiet zone stay.
qr.eye_flips_hint: Shapes with a direction look symmetric when the top-right eye is flipped horizontally and the bottom-left one vertically.
qr.gradient_on_eyes: Apply the gradient to the eyes
qr.eye_colors_hint: Every eye color needs the same contrast as the code.
qr.logo_mode_clean_hint: Modules under the logo are removed, with a one-module margin.
qr.logo_mode_overlay_hint: The logo is drawn over the modules; transparent parts of the logo show the code.
qr.checks_ok: Readable: every color passes the contrast check.
qr.problem_inverted: {{where}} is lighter than the background; light-on-dark codes fail on many scanners.
qr.problem_shape: Pick a shape from the lists.
qr.problem_quiet_zone: The quiet zone must be 4–16 modules.
qr.problem_logo: Check the logo settings (size 10–30%, photo or cover).
qr.problem_gradient: Check the gradient colors and angle.
qr.warning_low_margin: Some contrast is just above the minimum; test with a few phones before printing.
qr.warning_large_logo: A large logo hides many modules; test the code before printing.
qr.warning_logo_overlay: Modules under the logo stay; a busy or opaque logo hides them.
qr.warning_transparent: Transparent codes need a light surface behind them.
qr.warning_dense_shape: Small modules need a larger print size to scan from a distance.
qr.download_failed: The file could not be created in the browser. Use the server download.
qr.download_local_hint: SVG and PNG of the current design are created in your browser, identical to the server's files.
qr.download_server_hint: Downloads the saved design from the server (SVG, PNG or PDF).
qr.download_logo_server: This logo cannot be embedded in the browser; save and use the server download.
qr.download_dirty_hint: Download creates the current design in your browser; save first for the server file and PDF.
support.card_images.hint: Design images printed on the card. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Card 85.6×54 mm landscape; other ratios are cropped.
support.card_images.too_large: The image is larger than 5 MB
